body:
**Waves run 2026-07-22 — attempted, deferred.** A crew found (and I independently re-verified) that the issue's framing needs correction: the 3 skills at `hsb3/agent-native-sandbox` `.claude/skills/{visual-plan,visual-recap,visualize-repo}/` are NOT authored originals inspired by BuilderIO — each carries an `agent-native-skill.json` sidecar (`"source": "agent-native"`, `"installCommand": "npx @agent-native/core@latest skills add <name>"`, `"installedAt": "2026-07-19"`) proving they were installed from the upstream `@agent-native/core` package with only the ## Installed Mode preamble layered on top. Shipping them as `origin: authored` under `primitives-core/` would be a false provenance claim and would violate ADR 0015 (self-authored-only; promotion of an external means re-authoring, not copying the shipped body).

Separately: `ghcr.io/hsb3/plan-app` (in the Installed Mode preamble) fails `check_identity.py`'s unconditional `hsb3` ban — no container-image exemption exists today.

**Owner decision (2026-07-22): revisit later; the skills also still need to be tested** (live render proof against the container was never reached). Deferred — not scoped into this run's waves. Path forward when revisited is one of: (A) route through #36's externals-by-reference + clone-at-build mechanism (the compliant path, but blocked on #36's decisions 1-7), (B) genuinely re-author the 3 skills as first-party originals, or (C) an explicit documented ADR 0015 exception.
